scenario:
A financial services company is developing an enterprise-level market data analytics platform to manage and analyze real-time and historical trading data for various financial instruments, including options, futures, and equities. This platform is designed to support traders, financial analysts, and institutional investors who require timely and accurate data to make informed trading decisions.

The platform will ingest high-frequency trading data from multiple exchanges, capturing details such as ticker symbols, trade times, prices, volumes, and open interest. Users will have access to advanced analytical tools to perform technical analysis, identify trading patterns, and generate trading signals. Additionally, the system will provide historical data storage for backtesting trading strategies and performing comprehensive market research.

To ensure data integrity and ease of access, the platform will include robust user management features, allowing different roles such as traders, analysts, and administrators to access data based on their permissions. The system will also support the integration of third-party financial data feeds and APIs to enhance analytical capabilities. Furthermore, the platform will offer reporting tools to generate detailed market reports and insights for stakeholders.
